name: proportionalLiquidGravity
description: Liquid gravity is a proportion of normal gravity

name: velocityBlocksOnCollision
description: Velocity changes are caused by blocks are triggered by collision with the block

name: velocityBlocksOnTop
description: Velocity changes are caused by the block the player is standing on

name: fluidHeightFromFeet
description: A fluid counts as soon as its surface is above the bottom of the entity box (Entity.updateFluidHeightAndDoFluidPushing), instead of the 1.8 ceil(maxY) test on a box shrunk by 0.4

name: shallowLavaMovement
description: LivingEntity.travel splits lava into a shallow regime (height <= fluid jump threshold) with a distinct vertical rule; before 1.16 the whole lava velocity is scaled by lavaInertia and gravity/4 subtracted, with no split

name: climbUsingJump
description: Entity can climb ladders and vines by pressing jump

name: climbableTrapdoor
description: Trapdoors placed directly above ladders become climbable

name: sneakStopsSprinting
description: Sneaking stops a running sprint (the forward impulse drops below 0.8); since 1.14 sneaking only prevents starting one

name: sprintSurvivesMinorCollision
description: A horizontal collision within 8 degrees of the wanted direction (LocalPlayer.isHorizontalCollisionMinor) does not stop sprinting

name: headingAnglePiOver180
description: Entity.moveFlying turns the input by the angle yaw * 3.1415927F / 180.0F (two float roundings); since 1.9 by yaw * 0.017453292F

name: floatMoveRelative
description: Entity.moveRelative (moveFlying) scales the input in float, cut off below 1.0E-4F and divided by max(1, length); since 1.14 getInputVector does it in double, cut off below 1.0E-7 and normalized only when longer than 1

name: floatLengthNormalize
description: Vec3.normalize takes the length through Mth.sqrt, a float; since 1.17 Math.sqrt

name: groundSpeedFromInertia
description: LivingEntity's ground speed factor is 0.16277136F over the cube of friction * 0.91F; since 1.14 0.21600002F over the cube of the friction

name: groundSpeedConstantRoundedUp
description: The ground speed factor's constant is 0.16277137F instead of 0.16277136F
